How it works AI Scan runs automatically on pull requests when code scanning and the repository’s effective AI Scan setting are enabled. Findings appear alongside CodeQL results on the Conversation and Files changed tabs, with an “AI” indicator to distinguish them from CodeQL alerts. Findings can include an explanation of the security risk and a suggested autofix. AI Scan findings are advisory. They do not fail the code scanning check and cannot block pull request merges through ruleset requirements. AI Scan does not run on pull requests from forks or pull requests created by Dependabot.
